caption: The drawing depicts a three-legged, tripod-like object with a twisted or spiral design along its legs. Each of the three legs extends from a central point at the top and gradually spreads outward toward the bottom, ending in small hooked tips. At the top of the object, there is a small cylindrical cup or holder that is attached to one of the legs by a short, upward-curving arm. The drawing uses black or dark gray lines on a plain, beige or light tan background, with careful linework to suggest the texture and form of the object. There are no other objects or markings in the drawing aside from the artist's signature near the bottom right corner.
title: Rush and Candle Stand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
